title: Nexus AgentHostCreateSessionRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/daemon/agent-host/sessions. Legacy fields are unchanged. actor_ref and viewpoint are a pair: both absent is legacy, both present is Actor mode; supplying only one is rejected in the daemon.

provider_id.description: Provider identifier selected for the managed session.

cwd.description: Working directory for the session. Omitted or null uses the daemon default.
